item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - Rick and Morty Season 1 MULTi 1080p BluRay DD2.0/DD5.1 10bit H.265-MIXED [ALL AUDIO TRACKS AND SUBTITLES]
item.description:
Rick and Morty MULTi Audio - Season 1 1080p BluRay 10bit H.265
​

This release of season 1 contains EVERY AUDIO TRACK and EVERY SUBTITLE TRACK from the best possible sources, synced together from 10bit x265 encode of the original US BluRays. I spent THREE MONTHS trying to download every audio track and subtitle for this season ALONE, and it took way longer than I really thought it would.

Why did it take so long? As it turns out, syncing different audio tracks and subtitles together from completely different sources to the same BluRay copy, especially when some of these sources are synced to a sped up PAL format (streaming services intentionally doing a 24 to 25fps speed up is such a small thing for them to not do whatsoever but they do it anyway), is extremely tedious and nobody will be bothered to do it especially if nobody will notice the work, download, or appreciate what you've done. BUT!! I've finally fucking done it anyway. I wouldn't say this was a waste of time since it did get me re-invested in the show, and because I know theres some people out there who really want to watch the dubbed versions of Rick & Morty without having to go to the bottom-of-the-barrel piracy websites with millions of porn ads. Bless this site and bless this user base for giving me a platform to share it on!!

I will, eventually, also make MULTi audio releases of seasons 2 and 3 in the future as they also have audio commentaries and bonus features that make it necessary to compile this together, but that's it afterwards. I don't think it would be worth the effort to keep going.

HERE'S EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT WHAT I DID HERE:​
  • I DID NOT ENCODE THE VIDEO - I am using BugsFunny's H.265 10bit encode as a base. They will be credited in the MKV files themselves, and you can check the MediaInfo for their encoded video there on 1337x.
    • Extras from that release will be included for those who want them.
  • I synced all audio tracks together with the BluRay's visuals seamlessly using MAGIX VEGAS Pro. They are rendered in Stereo as they were produced and distributed that way, and will also match the Stereo DVD quality standard (Dolby Digital 192kbps). The quality loss is VERY very minimal and not noticeable, though. I tried my best to make sure it doesn't sound garbage.
    • The ONLY audio tampering I did is that I edited the Czech, French and Castilian dub of episode 11 to use the uncensored version of the "Rick Dance" song, but that is the only change I made. The song was left undubbed in those languages, but they initially used the censored version of the song. This is a very minor fan-change to make, but it is one I prefer significantly.
  • Almost ALL available OFFICIALLY PRODUCED audio and subtitles sources were ripped directly from HBO Max and Netflix - no fansubs or fandubs. If you want to know what audio languages were included, make sure to click on the MediaInfo tag.
  • I included the English Audio Description track as well, because, why not right?
  • There was a scene that was censored in Thailand on HBO (Rick chanting "Allah Akbar" at Mr. Goldenfold), so I had to find an uncensored version of that scene dubbed in Thai elsewhere thats not on an official streaming service.
  • The only audio tracks I did not include in this release due to their limited availability were the French dub produced in Quebec, and a completely different Polish dub that aired on Comedy Central in Poland. Hopefully this is not an issue for people, as I know some people out there love having choices and preferences, but they seemed to be way too rare to find online in full and not worth the effort.
  • These audio and subtitle files can also be seamlessly muxed with BluRay REMUX releases if you want the untampered uncompressed video to watch with these tracks.
Click to expand...
TL;DR - this is maybe the most convenient way (and maybe the only straightforward way) you can access, download and hear nearly all the dubs and read any subtitles for Rick and Morty without having to worry about the typical streaming service geo-blocking.
